arm_declaration.source: tools/PERF_INFRA.md, 'The smoke set' (the arm table: each arm's impairment, load shape and lanes), and the M3/M4 arm descriptions in rtp_mux/tests/mandate_smoke.rs; the cells restate what those documents already state and are not a second authority for any bound. The `probe/` keys name this crate's own perf-tier probes, whose cells are the `probe-*` rows of tests/GATE.md (family `probe`, reference lib::tests::clean_forwarding_perf_probe). The `mandate-compare` subcommand also reads each arm's cells to decide whether a counter it recorded is load-bearing for that arm — the rule, and what the declared cells can and cannot express, is in that tool's docstring.

mandates.duration_note: empty bracket: this MANDATE line was printed 0.004s after MANDATE M2's line, so the interval between the two verdict lines is not a duration this section spent -- at the report's 2-decimal resolution it is zero, which is what 'unmeasured' looks like too. The bracket is a section's own wall-clock only while one section runs inside it, and two sections that read one shared arm measurement print their lines in the same instant: the second closes an interval holding no run of its own, and the run it asserts on is timed inside the bracket of the section that measured it

timings.method: libtest-per-test-stamp: a test's duration is the time libtest itself reports for that test (the child is run with -Z unstable-options --report-time, so its result reads 'test <name> ... ok <1.234s>'), which libtest takes around that test's own execution and which therefore stays that test's own while the target's tests run concurrently. It is not a line's position in the stream, which under libtest's default parallelism is an artefact of the interleaving. A test whose result carries no stamp has a null duration and duration_source, and is never bracketed. A mandate's duration is still the bracket between its neighbouring MANDATE lines and is marked with that source, because the MANDATE line is printed from inside the test that measured the section and no per-section stamp exists, and a bracket this report's own resolution renders as '0.00s' is reported as absent with the note that says why rather than as a duration
